title: Contact
description: Contact N S Lootah Group in Dubai: the Group office’s telephone, email and WhatsApp, an enquiry form, and how to reach each of our companies.

hero.label: Contact
hero.lede: Whether you’re exploring a partnership, enquiring about one of our companies or simply want to connect, the Group office is the place to start.
hero.imageAlt: The Dubai skyline seen from above

office.label: Group office
office.lede: Our team will direct your enquiry to the right company.

form.label: Send an enquiry
form.lede: Tell us briefly what you have in mind and which company it concerns. The Group office reads every enquiry and passes it to the right team.
form.name: Full name
form.messagePlaceholder: A few lines about your enquiry.
form.consent: I agree that N S Lootah Group may contact me about this enquiry.

errors.invalid: Please add your name, a valid email address and a short message, and tick the consent box.
errors.send: Your enquiry couldn’t be sent just now. Please try again in a few minutes, or call us.
errors.limit: Too many enquiries from this connection in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.

companies.label: Our companies
companies.lede: Each company has its own team. Visit its page, or contact the Group office and we’ll connect you.

real-fresh.address: Al Mulla Warehouses, Al Qusais Industrial Area 1, Dubai

sent.title: Enquiry sent
sent.description: Thank you. Your enquiry has reached N S Lootah Group.
sent.label: Enquiry sent
sent.intro: The Group office will read it and reply to the email address you gave, or pass it to the company concerned.
